content: IPFS Cluster separates metadata state (pinset) from block bytes: state export writes a JSON stream (one Pin per line) via offline state manager; state import replaces existing state (restore-from-backup) and can override replication factors/allocations on import; state cleanup resets; sharness test proves export+cleanup+import is a no-op round-trip; import runs offline (daemon down) against GetOfflineState(store); stateless PinTracker reconciles desired pinset vs actual IPFS-node pins with Track/Untrack/Recover/RecoverAll and status per CID. Block bytes live in IPFS nodes, not in cluster state — backup of metadata plus pin re-fetch is the restore model.
